title.zh: 逐步选定的家族：只有持有前后所立者的条件把一步连到下一步，以不计次序的延续代替逐位跟随
title.en: Families chosen step by step: only a condition holding what stands before and after joins one step to the next, and continuity up to order replaces following position by position

claim.en: Where the family may change at each step (OneStep.StepRealized, with givers; OneStep.StepRunRealized, without), a sequence of patterns is shown by some world under no condition, under balance and under closure exactly when each step obeys its law (OneStep.step_every_iff, OneStep.step_balance_iff, OneStep.step_closed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff): these conditions join no step to the next. Running down holds in its family everything standing before and after its step, and there a sequence is shown exactly when each step obeys its law and the passages continue up to order: at each positive level, as many stand there after a step as before the next (OneStep.Continues; OneStep.step_runsDown_iff, OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff, OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff; OneStep.StepRealized.continues). Following position by position on one family gives continuity (OneStep.Chained.continues) and not conversely: a sequence of two idle conditions in swapped order runs down on families chosen step by step and on no single family (OneStep.steps_not_run), and a sequence shown under balance on chosen families is not shown under running down, its passages not continuing (OneStep.vanishing_steps). No premise.
claim.zh: 家族可以每步改变时（OneStep.StepRealized，带给予者；OneStep.StepRunRealized，不带），一串模式在无条件、平衡与封闭之下恰在每步遵守其规律时由某个世界显示（OneStep.step_every_iff、OneStep.step_balance_iff、OneStep.step_closed_iff、OneStep.stepRun_balance_iff）：这些条件不把一步连到下一步。耗减在其家族中持有该步之前与之后所立的一切，在那里一串模式恰在每步遵守其规律、且经过不计次序地延续时被显示：在每个正的水平上，一步之后立于那里的与下一步之前一样多（OneStep.Continues；OneStep.step_runsDown_iff、OneStep.step_runsDownClosed_iff、OneStep.stepRun_runsDown_iff、OneStep.stepRun_runsDownClosed_iff；OneStep.StepRealized.continues）。在一个家族上逐位跟随给出延续（OneStep.Chained.continues），反之不然：两个空闲条件次序交换的一串在逐步选定的家族上耗减，在任何单一家族上都不（OneStep.steps_not_run）；在选定家族上于平衡之下显示的一串在耗减之下不显示，其经过不延续（OneStep.vanishing_steps）。不加前提。

hypotheses.zh: 延续只对其家族持有一步前后所立者的条件推出（耗减）；只覆盖一侧的条件没有处理。
hypotheses.en: Continuity is derived only for conditions whose family holds what stands before and after the step (running down); conditions covering one side only are not treated.

correspondence.zh: P79b（工作板，P79 的延伸），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”，回答 laws-of-one-step-complete 的 next_delta。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：家族不必是固定的；逐步选定时，把一步连到下一步的只是所立者的延续，不是位置。见整合文档 §{S}。
correspondence.en: P79b (work board, extending P79), following Ren's ‘move towards 100%’ of 12 October 2026, answering the next_delta of laws-of-one-step-complete. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): a family need not be fixed; chosen step by step, what joins one step to the next is only the continuity of what stands, not position. See the integration document §{S}.

detail.zh: 复用模式、条件之律、见证世界与 Chained。
detail.en: Reuses the patterns, each condition's law, the witness world and Chained.

output.zh: 一步的规律与固定家族上的运行。
output.en: The laws of one step and runs on a fixed family.

input.zh: 逐步选定家族上的运行。
input.en: Runs on families chosen step by step.

detail.zh: 一步的规律对逐步选定的家族逐步成立。
detail.en: The laws of one step hold step by step on families chosen step by step.

detail.zh: swapped：逐步选定时耗减而在单一家族上不；vanishing：平衡之下显示而耗减之下不。
detail.en: swapped: runs down on families chosen step by step and on no single family; vanishing: shown under balance and not under running down.

limitations.zh: 只覆盖一侧的条件没有处理；容量与活动在运行上没有陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Conditions covering one side only are not treated; capacity and activity over runs are not stated; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; no ethical predicate occurs.

next_delta.zh: 只覆盖一侧的条件；容量与活动在运行上的形式。
next_delta.en: Conditions covering one side only; capacity and activity over runs.
